test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Throughout'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence mentions** that Horus, the falcon-headed god, has become one of the most commonly used symbols of Egypt, seen on Egyptian airplanes, hotels, and restaurants.
 
• The word **"throughout"** accurately conveys the idea that Horus is widely represented and can be observed extensively across Egypt.
 
• **It implies** that his symbol is found in various places throughout the country.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *seen on Egyptian airplanes, and on hotels and restaurants **throughout **the land. He is the son of Osiris and Isis, the divine child of the holy family triad.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation for the other options:
 
 
• **Alongside:** This option suggests a position or location next to or beside something. It does not capture the idea that Horus is found all over Egypt.
 
• **Away from: **This option indicates a direction of movement, suggesting that Horus is not present on Egyptian airplanes, hotels, and restaurants. It contradicts the statement that he is commonly seen in these places.
 
• **Outside:** This option suggests a location or position beyond or external to a particular area. It does not convey the sense of widespread presence and visibility that the sentence implies.
